title: glencore mercuria among firms pursuing venezuela aluminum smelter deal bloomberg 2026 09 11
text:
Sept 11 (Reuters) - London-listed miner Glencore (GLEN.L)
, opens new tab
 and Swiss-based commodities ​trader Mercuria Energy are among firms interested in a ‌deal for Venezuela's largest aluminium smelter, Bloomberg News reported on Friday.
The two companies are in separate discussions with the Venezuelan government about ​a deal for the Venalum smelter that could include ​operating the facility and gaining access to the aluminium ⁠it produces, according to people familiar with the matter.
